entries.what: GET /lol/summoner/v4/summoners/by-name/{name} is gone from Riot's summoner-v4 reference, which lists only by-puuid. Riot said it would be removed but no dated notice was found, so diedOn is the day the reference was read without it.

source.quote: GET /lol/summoner/v4/summoners/by-puuid/{encryptedPUUID} Get a summoner by PUUID.

entries.replacement: ACCOUNT-V1 /riot/account/v1/accounts/by-riot-id/{gameName}/{tagLine} for a PUUID, then summoner-v4 by-puuid.
requires: Names become a game name and a tag line, so a lookup by summoner name alone has no direct replacement.
The API routes ACCOUNT-V1 by region (americas, asia, europe), not by platform such as na1.

entries.what: SummonerDTO no longer has name or accountId: the reference lists profileIconId, revisionDate, puuid and summonerLevel. No dated notice was found, so diedOn is the day the reference was read. A field called name on an app's own summoner row reads the same, so these need reading.

source.quote: puuid string Encrypted PUUID. Exact length of 78 characters. summonerLevel long Summoner level associated with the summoner.

lookFor: A read of .name or .accountId off a summoner object from summoner-v4
entries.replacement: puuid from SummonerDTO, and gameName and tagLine from ACCOUNT-V1.
requires: Rows stored under a summoner name or accountId need a migration to puuid.
